regular_vs_none.sharpness_note: Win-rate difference bounds are sharp when both arms have fixed numeric outcomes, or their feasible memberships do not overlap. Mean-net-bp bounds are guaranteed sharp when feasible memberships do not overlap; with overlap they are conservative outer bounds.
regular_vs_none.denominator_note: Bounds use numeric-net_bp events per arm. Denominators range from mandatory to all feasible arm members. Events with no feasible set are excluded, never assigned to none.
